name: file_doctor
description: Multi-function file surgeon: reads, writes, appends, replaces strings/regex, generates diffs, patches, checks syntax, executes shell/test commands, and rolls back backups.

action.description: The file or execution operation to perform

target.description: Target file or directory path (resolves relative to agent workspace)

find.description: Target substring or regex pattern for 'replace' action

is_regex.description: Whether 'find' is a regular expression in 'replace' action (default: false)

command.description: Shell command to run for 'execute' action (e.g., 'pytest tests/', 'cargo check')
